audit.scope: Six untracked files in C:/Users/jdk/dispatch-board-worktrees/PBI-003 (branch pbi/PBI-003-records-schema, base fd7b926). Intent rung 1: docs/backlog/specs/pbi-003-records-schema.md revision 4, deviation assessment against sections 2-6 and AC-D1..AC-D7. Grounding: the three suites run in the worktree, in-memory and temp-file probes, a scratch commit-and-clone under autocrlf, and reasoning. No SARIF or SAST.
audit.summary: 1 HIGH, 0 MEDIUM, 4 LOW. Spec fidelity: SHAPES, validate, id forms, store_path, TABLES, to_row/from_row and create_schema match sections 3-4; the transaction mechanism is correct in all five connection modes. The one problematic departure is the byte-exact shapes-copy assertion, which fails on a git checkout with autocrlf (AC-D7). Verdict NO-GO.

findings.title: The local suite fails after merge: the shapes-copy test compares bytes, and git checks the JSON out as CRLF

evidence.value: core.autocrlf=true; no .gitattributes; 95 of 95 tracked files i/lf w/crlf
json.loads(text) == SHAPES True; exact text equal False; has CRLF True

findings.impact: After merge the local suite goes red in the main checkout; AC-D7 unmet.
findings.remediation: Keep the json.loads equality; normalise newlines before the canonical-text comparison.

findings.title: to_row and from_row can raise TypeError, AttributeError or KeyError instead of ValueError; 1e999 comes back as inf

evidence.value: set/bytes/mixed keys -> TypeError; bytes/None/tuple -> AttributeError; mapping without doc -> KeyError; '{"a": 1e999}' -> inf

findings.impact: A collector catching ValueError per record would crash on a malformed doc.
findings.remediation: Re-raise TypeError as ValueError; accept only str or mapping with str doc; parse_float hook rejecting non-finite values.

findings.title: Double-quoted column names let SQLite build an index on a constant, so create_schema marks a broken file as version 1

evidence.value: CREATE TABLE runs (x); create_schema succeeds, user_version 1; the index is on the constant 'session'

findings.impact: A loud failure and rollback becomes a silent useless index on a foreign or corrupted file.
findings.remediation: Emit identifiers unquoted, or check PRAGMA table_info before setting user_version.

findings.title: No test pins SHAPES to section 3.1

evidence.value: tests iterate records.SHAPES; TABLES is pinned literally, SHAPES is not

findings.impact: Loosening a type or dropping a required field passes the suite.
findings.remediation: Assert SHAPES equals a literal copy of section 3.1.

findings.title: Each conformance run leaves its temp folder behind (read-only git objects defeat rmtree ignore_errors on Windows)
findings.remediation: rmtree with onexc/onerror that chmods and retries.

not_audited.reason: No SARIF or SAST; reasoning only; nothing found.

follow_ups: Spec: section 3.1 says only 'enums' may be omitted from a SPEC, but its nested catalogue specs omit 'optional' too; amend the spec text.
